items.html: And it is already known that Leah stands above the Keter of Rachel; and it follows that the entire Partzuf of Leah, and also the Keter of Rachel, were sawed on this day. And also for this reason this day is called "harsh judgment" (Dina Kashya), for it is known that the aspects of Leah are harsh judgments, and those of Rachel are "soft judgment" (Dina Rafya).
